id.description:

en-US.title: It wasn't just the car that was damaged.
en-US.description:
In cases of property damage, the prevailing practice is to recognize consolation money only to a limited extent, as it is generally assumed that damages are fully recovered through compensation for pecuniary losses, such as repair costs.

However, this case is an instance where separate consolation money was awarded, taking into account that the acts were retaliatory and threatening behaviors that occurred within a romantic relationship.

This video was produced using AI and contains scenes that may evoke fear; please exercise caution when watching.
